subject: QUEUED BACKLOG: GROK-3 — Pass Protection PBWR vs PRWR Pressure Decay Engine
body:
Grok: Queued pipeline task (to begin immediately following GROK-2 completion).

Objective: Factor A21 Trench & Pressure Modeling on 2019-2025 nflverse data.
1. Match ESPN Pass Block Win Rate (PBWR) and Pass Rush Win Rate (PRWR) against weekly team matchups.
2. Fit pressure probability as a function of PBWR - PRWR differential and backup tackle counts.
3. Quantify QB EPA/play and sack rate elasticities under high-pressure regimes.
4. Output to out/grok_trench_pressure_results.json.
